title: Option to show multiple clocks with different timezones on lock screen
line: The lock screen can now show extra clocks for other time zones, picked in its Appearance settings.
explanation: The Breeze lock screen only showed the time and date of the system time zone, and its settings had no way to add others, so seeing the time in another place needed unlocking. The lock screen settings (Screen Locking > Configure Appearance) now have an "Other time zones" list with an "Add Time Zone…" button that opens the same map time zone picker used by the Date & Time settings; each chosen zone shows up on the lock screen as a small time and city label under the date, using the same Clock type as the Digital Clock's extra time zones.

commits.message:
lockscreen: allow showing clocks for other time zones

The lock screen could only show the time of the system time zone, so
checking the time back home or of a colleague meant unlocking first. Its
settings can now list extra time zones, shown as small clocks under it.

BUG: 368325

From 445c80ef0d3d809f0cc68b460675f2db6361ca9b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 22:50:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lockscreen: allow showing clocks for other time zones

The lock screen could only show the time of the system time zone, so
checking the time back home or of a colleague meant unlocking first. Its
settings can now list extra time zones, shown as small clocks under it.

BUG: 368325
---
 .../contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml      | 46 +++++++++++
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml | 78 +++++++++++++++++++
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.xml |  4 +
 3 files changed, 128 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
index 065a33c131..da4e7a248c 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
@@ -13,6 +13,7 @@ import QtQuick.Controls
 import QtQuick.Layouts
 import Qt5Compat.GraphicalEffects
 
+import org.kde.plasma.clock as PlasmaClock
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents3
 import org.kde.plasma.private.accessibility
 import org.kde.plasma.workspace.components as PW
@@ -271,6 +272,51 @@ Item {
             anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
             y: (mainBlock.userList.y + mainStack.y)/2 - height/2
             Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignBaseline
+
+            RowLayout {
+                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
+                Layout.topMargin: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+                spacing: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2
+                visible: config.timeZones.length > 0
+
+                Repeater {
+                    model: config.timeZones
+
+                    ColumnLayout {
+                        id: timeZoneClock
+
+                        required property string modelData
+
+                        spacing: 0
+
+                        PlasmaClock.Clock {
+                            id: timeZoneSource
+                            timeZone: timeZoneClock.modelData
+                        }
+
+                        PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+                            text: Qt.formatTime(timeZoneSource.dateTime, Qt.locale(), Locale.ShortFormat)
+                            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                            style: lockScreenUi.softwareRendering ? Text.Outline : Text.Normal
+                            styleColor: lockScreenUi.softwareRendering ? Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor : "transparent"
+                            font.pointSize: Math.round(Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pointSize * 1.8)
+                            font.weight: Font.DemiBold
+                            font.features: { "tnum": 1 }
+                            renderType: Text.NativeRendering
+                            Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
+                        }
+                        PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+                            text: timeZoneClock.modelData.split("/").pop().split("_").join(" ")
+                            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                            style: lockScreenUi.softwareRendering ? Text.Outline : Text.Normal
+                            styleColor: lockScreenUi.softwareRendering ? Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor : "transparent"
+                            font.pointSize: Math.round(Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pointSize * 1.2)
+                            renderType: Text.NativeRendering
+                            Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
 
         ListModel {
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml
index 0ac9414ae8..f94266677c 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/config.qml
@@ -1,7 +1,9 @@
 import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+import QtQuick.Layouts
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
+import org.kde.plasma.workspace.timezoneselector as TimeZone
 
 Kirigami.FormLayout {
     id: configForm
@@ -12,6 +14,9 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
     property bool cfg_alwaysShowClockDefault: true
     property bool cfg_hideClockWhenIdleDefault: false
 
+    property list<string> cfg_timeZones
+    property list<string> cfg_timeZonesDefault: []
+
     property alias cfg_showMediaControls: showMediaControls.checked
     property bool cfg_showMediaControlsDefault: false
 
@@ -63,6 +68,79 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
         }
     }
 
+    ColumnLayout {
+        Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop",
+                                        "@label list of extra clocks showing other time zones",
+                                        "Other time zones:")
+        Kirigami.FormData.labelAlignment: Qt.AlignTop
+        enabled: configForm.cfg_alwaysShowClock
+        spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+        Repeater {
+            model: configForm.cfg_timeZones
+
+            RowLayout {
+                id: timeZoneRow
+
+                required property string modelData
+                required property int index
+
+                spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+                QQC2.Label {
+                    text: timeZoneRow.modelData.split("/").join(", ").split("_").join(" ")
+                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                }
+
+                QQC2.ToolButton {
+                    icon.name: "edit-delete-remove"
+                    text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "Remove this time zone")
+                    display: QQC2.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+                    QQC2.ToolTip.text: text
+                    QQC2.ToolTip.visible: hovered
+                    QQC2.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
+                    onClicked: configForm.cfg_timeZones = configForm.cfg_timeZones.filter((_, i) => i !== timeZoneRow.index)
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        QQC2.Button {
+            text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "Add Time Zone…")
+            icon.name: "list-add-symbolic"
+            onClicked: timeZoneDialog.open()
+
+            KCM.SettingHighlighter {
+                highlight: configForm.cfg_timeZones.join() !== configForm.cfg_timeZonesDefault.join()
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    Kirigami.Dialog {
+        id: timeZoneDialog
+
+        title: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@title:window", "Choose Time Zone")
+        parent: QQC2.Overlay.overlay
+        padding: 0
+        standardButtons: Kirigami.Dialog.Cancel
+        customFooterActions: Kirigami.Action {
+            text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "Add Selected Time Zone")
+            icon.name: "list-add-symbolic"
+            enabled: timeZoneSelector.selectedTimeZone !== ""
+                && !configForm.cfg_timeZones.includes(timeZoneSelector.selectedTimeZone)
+            onTriggered: {
+                configForm.cfg_timeZones = [...configForm.cfg_timeZones, timeZoneSelector.selectedTimeZone];
+                timeZoneDialog.close();
+            }
+        }
+        onClosed: timeZoneSelector.selectedTimeZone = ""
+
+        TimeZone.TimezoneSelector {
+            id: timeZoneSelector
+            implicitWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 40
+            implicitHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 25
+        }
+    }
+
     QQC2.CheckBox {
         id: showMediaControls
         Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop",

     <entry name="showMediaControls" type="Bool">
       <label>If true, shows any currently playing media along with controls to pause it.</label>
       <default>true</default>
